_transcription: ENGLISH half only, CBSE Class 10 Science (086), set 31/5/2 (Series CABD5/5), follower of opener 31/5/1. 27 page images, cover announces 27 printed pages. idx 0 cover, idx 1 Hindi instructions, idx 2 English instructions + Q1; English on EVERY EVEN index 2-26, Hindi on every odd index 1-25 (each the Hindi of the page after it); odd-page tops checked on the contact sheet, all Hindi; last page idx 26 English (Q39(b), (c)). Instructions confirm sci80: 39 questions, A Q1-20 MCQ (17-20 Assertion-Reason), B 21-26 x2, C 27-33 x3, D 34-36 x5, E 37-39 x4. Instruction (viii) prints NO count of internal choices, so the roster was built by walking the marking scheme (ms idx 2-9, every footer 'X SCIENCE 31/5/2'): a bare OR after Q21, 23, 27, 34, 35, 36, 37(c), 38(c), 39(c) = 9 alternatives, each confirmed against a printed OR on the paper. plan.txt gave no skip list; shared questions were matched by CONTENT against data/2024-31-5-1.questions.json and confirmed on this paper's own pages: 43 rows reuse the reference text byte for byte, 11 are new or re-authored (Q1, Q7, Q22, Q24, Q25, Q26 (500 C / 25 mA became 750 C / 15 mA), Q28, Q30, Q32, Q34(a), Q34(b)). All 20 Section-A answers are CBSE's own, read off the scheme page image (ms idx 2); each was re-derived and agrees. No void or unconditional-award note anywhere in the scheme (the only note, Q37(c)(ii) 'Deduct 1/2 mark if direction of rays is not shown', is conditional). The scheme heads Section D as 'SECTION C' (a scheme typo; the paper prints SECTION D). Decimal points on this paper are RAISED (Q35: 1{\cdot}5 V, 0{\cdot}2 mm, 1{\cdot}6). Case studies print (a), (b), (c)(i) OR (c)(ii).
